 categories are:
•
Category N: No symptoms or one of the conditions
noted in the Adult Classiﬁ cation Category A.
•
Category A: Mild symptoms, including two or more 
symptoms of dermatitis, lymphadenopathy, hepatomeg-
aly, parotitis, recurrent or persistent upper respiratory 
infection, or splenomegaly.
•
Category B: Moderate symptoms that may be attributed
to HIV infection, including anemias (low hemoglobin,
neutropenia, thrombocytopenia that persists), a single
episode of bacterial infection, candidiasis, cardiomy-
opathy, hepatitis, herpes simplex (recurrent), lymphoid
interstitial pneumonia, nephropathy, persistent fever or
diarrhea, and others.
•
Category C: Severe symptoms, including all the condi-
tions in Adult Category C.
